summary: Prompt 8F frontend testing on Activities & Events wizard flow, draft restore banner, RSVP micro-feedback, and Focus mode Pomodoro. All 6 requested flows pass end-to-end with correct French labels, bordeaux primary buttons, and constructive tone hints.

FormWizard footer is `sticky bottom-0` with `-mx-6` inside the shadcn Dialog; check on very small viewports that the primary button remains visible (Escape works but the sticky bar may overlap fields). Not blocking.
